crew.overview: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.
crew.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

crew.overview: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.
crew.title: Black Panther

crew.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
crew.title: Black Widow

details.biography:
Nicole Rowley is a Los Angeles–based visual effects producer. She gained early experience in the industry as an intern and production assistant on the film Charlie Wilson’s War (2007), which inspired her to build a career overseeing the visual effects process and contributing to creative decision‑making in film production. Over the course of more than a decade, she advanced from assistant roles to become a production manager and eventually a producer, working directly with film studios rather than at post‑production facilities.

Her film credits include working as Visual Effects Production Manager on Black Panther (2018), and serving as Visual Effects Producer on Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022), Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire (2024), and Supergirl (2026). She garnered particular praise from visual effects supervisor Geoffrey Baumann, who called her “an amazing partner” whose commitment was essential to the production of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022). Additionally, in one production noted for its ghostly visuals, she was identified alongside Baumann as the VFX producer responsible for overseeing the visual effects unit.

Nicole Rowley has also been recognised beyond her film work. In 2020, she was featured in a “Dynamic Women Award” profile, which highlighted her dedication, hard work, and progression from production assistant to producer over more than ten years in visual effects. The piece noted her commitment to sustainability, animal welfare, and a plant-based lifestyle, as well as her journey of coming out and the support she received from her community.
details.name: Nicole Rowley
